If • EthTSynImmediateTimeSync is set to TRUE • and the timeBaseUpdateCounter [timeBaseId] for the updated Time Base resp. timeBaseId has been changed • and the GLOBAL_TIME_BASE bit within the timeBaseStatus, which is read from StbM, is set, EthTSyn shall trigger an immediate transmission of Time Synchronization messages belonging to this Time Base.
